title: What are managers for?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What is the most useful thing a good manager actually does?
Can an excellent technical employee become a poor manager? Why?
How much freedom should a manager give experienced employees?
What should a manager do when two strong employees cannot work well together?
Would you rather work for a very demanding manager who helps you grow or a relaxed manager who gives you complete freedom?
